column1: 46967§choose§tʃuːz§v. （chose, chosen, choosing）选择；决定§You must choose between the red bag and the blue one.§你必须在红色的包和蓝色的包之间**选择**。§

46980§procedure§=§n. 程序，手续§You must follow the correct procedure when you borrow books from the library.§从图书馆借书时，你必须遵守正确的**程序**。§换例句：参考例句偏难（cumbersome）

46987§close§kləʊs§adj. 近的；亲密的 adv. 近，靠近 v. 关，关闭§My best friend lives close to my school, so we walk home together.§我最好的朋友住得离学校很**近**，所以我们一起走路回家。§

46994§break§=§v. （broke, broken, breaking）打破，弄坏；撕开 n. 间歇；休息§Be careful, or you will break the window with that ball.§小心点，不然你会用那个球把窗户**打破**的。§
46995§spirit§ˈspɪrɪt§n. 精神；灵魂§The team showed a strong spirit and never gave up.§这支队伍表现出顽强的**精神**，从不放弃。§
46996§nobody§ˈnəʊbədi§pron. 没有人，谁也不 n. 小人物§Nobody knew where the cat had gone.§**没有人**知道猫去了哪里。§
